title: Digital
slide_intent: Show how hierarchy changes between an email, a website, video and an app. Each surface offers a different amount of space for a story and a next action.
strategic_value: Photography, type strips and color can link editorial and promotional touchpoints while making room for the controls each medium needs.
demonstration: A tall newsletter and broad website window sit beside two video thumbnails and a tablet-shaped app specimen on a cyan field.
practical_value: Compare how the same assets behave in a single newsletter column, a website story grid and a video title card before specifying a digital format.

content_islands.name: Newsletter
content_islands.spec: Keep its title with a narrow scrolling composition of image, headline and copy.

content_islands.name: Website
content_islands.spec: Give the largest central area to the browser window, including navigation, lead story and a row of related stories.

content_islands.name: Video and app
content_islands.spec: Stack the two video examples above the app screen in the right column; keep all format labels attached.
